attributes.title: Primary Care Conference Hawaii 2027
attributes.venue: The Westin Maui Resort and Spa, Ka'anapali
attributes.cme_provider: Creighton University Health Sciences Continuing Education
attributes.organizer: Creighton University Health Sciences Continuing Education
attributes.summary:
Creighton University's Primary Care Conference Hawaii runs Monday to Thursday, February 15 to 18, 2027, at The Westin Maui Resort and Spa in Ka'anapali. It is in-person only and open to physicians, PAs, NPs, pharmacists, nurses, dentists and trainees.

The program carries 13.25 CE hours from Creighton, which is jointly accredited for physician, pharmacy and nursing education. Registration is a flat $1,095 with no discounts, and a room block is held at the resort. The detailed schedule had not yet been published when we checked.
